nodes.summary: For some odd prime $p$ there is a finite $p$-group $G$ such that no generating set of $G$ consists of elements that all have the same order. This answers Kourovka Problem 11.6 (Bagiński) in the negative (O'Brien, Scoppola and Vaughan-Lee).
nodes.title: Finite p-groups without a generating set of elements of equal order

nodes.summary: The statement that for every odd prime $p$, every finite $p$-group $G$ has a generating set $S$ all of whose elements have the same order.
nodes.title: Generating sets of equal order in finite p-groups (Kourovka 11.6)
